personality_one_liner: A sleek, high-performance, Spotify-inspired music streaming command center engineered for instant playback and immersive audio experiences.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with compact module spacing for fast media scanning

do's: Use translucent frosted glass for bottom mini-player and sticky header overlays
Ensure 75%+ surface tint for optimal contrast over scrolling album grids
dont's: Do not blur form inputs or active modal sheets
Do not stack more than two blur layers on a single screen

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure authentication supporting custom email/password, Google Sign-in, and Invidious/Piped endpoint configuration.

states.loading: Authenticating credentials and verifying endpoint connection...
states.empty: Enter your credentials or configure your custom music provider endpoint.
states.error: Authentication failed or endpoint unreachable. Please verify network and keys.

screens.layout: Centered immersive card with Spotify Green primary button, email/password inputs, Google SSO pill, and settings trigger for custom API endpoint configuration.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discovery hub featuring recently played, personalized mix recommendations, and quick-access top tracks.

states.empty: No recent listening history. Start exploring top charts or search for your favorite artists.
states.error: Unable to fetch music discovery feed. Tap to retry connection.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with top greeting header, horizontal quick-access grid of 6 recently played items, followed by vertical carousels of featured albums and curated playlists.

screens.name: Search
screens.purpose: Global discovery and categorization search for songs, artists, albums, and playlists with instant autocomplete.

states.empty: No tracks or artists found matching your query.
states.error: Search service unavailable. Check your custom endpoint connection.

screens.layout: Top sticky search bar with filter chips (Songs, Artists, Playlists, Albums), transitioning from zero-state category exploration cards to live autocomplete result lists.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: Local persistent music library managing custom playlists, favorites, followed artists, and offline downloads.

states.empty: Your library is empty. Save songs, albums, or create playlists to build your collection.
states.error: Failed to sync local library data. Tap to reload.

screens.layout: Header with user avatar and filter pills (Playlists, Artists, Downloaded), sorting dropdown, and a vertical list of saved items with thumbnail art and action triggers.

screens.name: Player
screens.purpose: Full-screen media player featuring real-time synchronized LRC lyrics, playback controls, equalizer, and sleep timer.

states.loading: Buffering audio stream and loading lyrics...
states.error: Playback error encountered. Please check network or switch Invidious endpoint.

screens.layout: Full bleed album art backdrop with gradient scrim, track title and artist metadata, interactive seek bar, primary playback controls, and sliding lyric view.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configuration hub for Invidious/Piped API endpoints, audio quality, theme switching, and equalizer presets.
screens.layout: Structured vertical settings list grouped by Audio Streaming, Custom Endpoints & Keys, Themes & Appearance, and Account Management.

hero_album.alt: Spotify dark theme album art cover

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement ShriMusic with a sleek Spotify-inspired dark theme (#121212 canvas, #282828 elevated cards, #1DB954 Spotify Green accent).
Provide bottom navigation tabs (Home, Search, Library, Settings) with a sticky mini-player above the tab bar for persistent background audio control.
Build a robust custom endpoint configuration screen for Invidious/Piped/YouTube API keys and fallback instances.
Ensure full support for Auth (Email/Password + Google Sign-In) and a full-screen player with synced LRCLIB lyrics.
Comply strictly with design guidelines: touch targets >= 44x44pt, safe area handling, gradient scrims on imagery, and zero forbidden purple/indigo hues.
